title: The boot budget re-measured after four days of the town's people
items: The first visit to the 1835 street now downloads 44.9 MB, 0.2 MB more than on November 10. Nearly all of it is the people's code and records: their mouths, faces and dress, and the new sign-in and window controls. The budget moves to 45.2 MB, with what grew written down file by file, so every pull request's build can go green again.
